name: io.github.abliteratedllm/mcp-server
title: AbliteratedLLM
description: Browse AbliteratedLLM models and prices, check your balance, and call its models from any MCP host.

environmentVariables.name: ABLITERATEDLLM_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: API key from https://abliteratedllm.dev/dashboard/keys. Needed for chat and get_balance; a key with a daily spend cap is recommended.

environmentVariables.name: ABLITERATEDLLM_TIMEOUT_SECONDS
environmentVariables.description: Seconds chat waits for a reply, 1 to 600. Raise it only if your MCP host allows tool calls longer than 60 seconds.
